title: Senior Director, People & Culture
description: Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT BUILDING LEADERS, SHAPING CULTURE, AND ENABLING BUSINESS SUCCESS The Senior Director, People & Culture is a pivotal senior role within our London Office and a key member of Catapult's global P&C leadership team. Working three days in the office and partnering closely with senior business leaders, you will drive strategic impact while shaping both the culture and operational effectiveness of the EMEA region. Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, based in Melbourne, you will lead an in-region team of three and be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enable, engage, develop and retain exceptional talent. Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution. You will thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and be energised by creating innovative, scalable solutions that strengthen leadership capability and foster a high-performance culture across the region. WHAT YOU'LL DO Develop and execute strategic workforce plans, coaching senior leaders on organisational design, change management, communication, and talent development to drive engagement, retention, and business performance. Shape culture and values by identifying organisational needs and implementing impactful, scalable people solutions. Drive a consistent, high-quality employee experience across the EMEA region, spanning three offices, 16 countries, and multiple employment frameworks. Provide hands-on support and strategic partnership to leaders, teams, and employees, ensuring people strategies are aligned with business goals. Partner with the Talent team to deliver strategic initiatives across learning and development, diversity, equity and inclusion, reward, workforce planning, and talent acquisition. Mentor and lead regional P&C team members, fostering a high-performance culture. Leverage data and insights to identify trends, inform decision-making, and influence strategic outcomes. WHAT YOU'LL NEED A commercial mindset and the ability to connect people decisions to business outcomes, building credibility and influence with senior leaders across regions and cultures. Significant People & Culture leadership experience in a multi-country EMEA environment, with working knowledge of UK and German employment law. Proven success partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth, global organisation to drive transformation and business outcomes. The ability to balance competing priorities across the employee lifecycle without compromising quality or attention to detail. Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex challenges. A strategic yet hands-on approach, balancing pace with employee development, engagement, and belonging. Experience designing creative, commercially driven solutions to complex business challenges. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation. High levels of energy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. A passion for creating a market-leading employee experience and fostering a high-performance culture. Flexibility to work across global time zones when required. WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months, you have built strong relationships with senior leaders and key stakeholders and are recognised as a trusted P&C partner. You have a clear understanding of workforce opportunities, challenges, and priorities, with a defined view of how P&C can enable business performance. Your direct team is aligned on priorities, ways of working, and expectations, and regional P&C processes are operating with consistency and quality. In 12 months time, you are driving meaningful impact through strategic workforce initiatives, stronger leadership capability, and an enhanced employee experience. Leaders are empowered to navigate people challenges effectively, global P&C initiatives are successfully embedded across teams, and data and insights are being used to inform decisions. You are a valued member of the global P&C leadership team, helping shape and deliver a high-performance culture across Catapult. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role. title: Senior HR Project Manager
description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior HR Project Manager to join our HR Transformation team, based in our Leeds office. Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders, with the credibility to command the room. Exceptional communication, emotional intelligence, and conflict management skills when navigating complex change. Strong commercial acumen and a structured, pragmatic approach to delivering business-aligned outcomes. Experience working in a mature, fast-paced corporate environment (preferably across international locations). NICE TO HAVES Exposure to AI transformation projects or leveraging modern AI tools within HR workflows. Familiarity with project management software such as Monday.com , Smartsheet, or MS Project. A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, complimentary snacks and drinks, as well as breakfasts and lunches on a weekly basis A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. title: Senior Data Analyst  (Marketing Analytics)
description: What is the job? We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing Analytics to help us uncover what’s truly driving growth, understand where the biggest opportunities lie and shape where we focus next. This is a high-impact, hands-on senior individual contributor role for someone who loves getting under the skin of the data, connecting the dots behind performance and turning complex findings into clear, commercially meaningful action. You’ll be equally excited by the technical side of analytics - working with data, tools and reporting infrastructure - as you are by solving real business problems and influencing decisions. Working closely with teams across paid media, CRM and lifecycle marketing, you’ll become a trusted partner to the wider marketing function. You’ll help us understand how our channels and campaigns are performing, identify the behaviours and trends that matter, and provide the insight needed to make smarter decisions about investment, optimisation and growth. This is much more than a reporting role. You’ll challenge assumptions, ask the questions others may not have considered and bring clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. You’ll help shape how we measure success, improve the quality and accessibility of our marketing data, and build a stronger understanding of the full customer journey. We’re looking for someone who is naturally curious, commercially minded and confident working independently. You’ll be comfortable setting your own direction, prioritising the work that will create the greatest value and getting on with delivering meaningful, measurable impact. What will you be doing? Partner with marketing teams to provide clear, actionable insights on performance across channels including Google, Meta, Social and CRM. Analyse marketing spend and outcomes to support optimisation and better decision-making. Own and evolve our GA4 setup, ensuring tracking is robust and focused on meaningful performance metrics. Work with CRM teams to analyse lifecycle journeys, retention, and engagement using a variety of data sources. Act as the internal owner for marketing data requirements, working with Analytics Engineers to ensure data models and dashboards meet real business needs. Lead the development of advanced measurement, beyond basic attribution, moving from LTV and CAC towards incrementality. Communicate insights clearly through dashboards, presentations, and conversations with senior stakeholders. What do you need? Experience with digital analytics, ideally in a fast-paced or growth-focused environment. Hands-on experience with SQL is a must, BigQuery, GA4, Looker, and Google Sheets are a plus. Comfortable working across a broad marketing function and building strong relationships with non-technical stakeholders. Experience collaborating with data or analytics engineering teams, clearly defining requirements and translating insight into action. title: Operations Engineer
description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it. You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. What you'll own Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them. Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource. Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven. Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it. What we're looking for AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more. Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting. In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done. First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that. Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you. You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority How we work There are five things we care about deeply: Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster. This role is probably not for you if You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is; You prefer close management of your responsibilities; You are risk-averse; You want a 9-5; You take yourself too seriously; You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact Salary £70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity. Hiring process Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. Location & ways of working We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office. Benefits Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total) Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Chief of Staff, Global Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://redditinc.com" data-sk="tooltip_parent">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div></div><p>As the Chief of Staff to the EVP of Global Ad Sales, you will serve as a high-leverage strategic operator, executive proxy, and force multiplier across the Global Sales Organization (GSO). Your key function is to scale executive attention, accelerate decision velocity, and translate GSO’s highest strategic priorities into clear execution and follow-through.</p> <p>The ideal Chief of Staff operates with high EQ to maintain Reddit’s open, collaborative, and accessible culture while ensuring that executive time is prioritized for high-impact drivers. You will partner closely with Sales Strategy & Operations, regional sales leadership, and cross-functional executive teams to orchestrate a seamless operational rhythm and drive global alignment.</p> <p><strong>This role is required to be based in New York or London.</strong></p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Drive Alignment & Prioritization</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Filter & Route Inquiries:</strong> Establish clear operational paths for routine data requests, incident reporting, and tactical items below the executive level, freeing leadership bandwidth for major revenue initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Executive Proxy & Strategic Alignment:</strong> Represent the EVP in key cross-functional leadership forums, planning reviews, and offsites, building bottoms-up consensus and alignment before issues require top-down intervention.</li> <li><strong>Surface Field Signals:</strong> Synthesize customer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and field feedback directly from front-line sales teams to keep executive leadership deeply connected to market realities.</li> <li><strong>Pre-Frame Executive Decisions:</strong> Ensure material revenue proposals and strategic escalations reaching the EVP are pre-framed with clear context and explicit recommendations, allowing leadership to focus on high-order strategic decisions.</li> </ul> <li><em>Operational Rhythm & Business Cadence</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Orchestrate Business Cadence: </strong>Maintain the global sales operational rhythm, including leadership reviews, quarterly business reviews, strategic offsites, and key team communication forums, ensuring priorities are proactively tracked and fire drills are minimized.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Alignment with Sales Strategy & Operations:</strong> Partner seamlessly with Sales Strategy & Operations by translating strategic outputs into operational workstreams, leadership narratives, and review frameworks.</li> <li><strong>Executive Communications & Collateral:</strong> Drive end-to-end preparation of strategic collateral, executive presentations, board materials, and organizational communications in close coordination with Internal Comms partners.</li> </ul> <li><em>Track Strategic Priorities & Follow-Through</em></li> <ul> <li><strong>Track & Report on Key Commercial Initiatives:</strong> Track high-priority commercial initiatives and global sales bets, ensuring every key initiative has a clearly defined owner, success metrics, and milestones.</li> <li><strong>Accountability & Execution:</strong> Ensure regional and functional leaders leave executive reviews with clear action items and deadlines; track ongoing performance against overarching organization priorities.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Initiative Support:</strong> Drive alignment and operational support for complex, multi-functional sales initiatives across GTM, Product, Marketing, and SS&O. </li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications: </strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of relevant experience in a Sales/revenue/business strategy & operations role within an ad sales organization</li> <li>Deep understanding of the rhythm of the business in a high-growth environment</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to synthesize complex data/insights and build actionable strategies around the highest impact opportunities</li> <li>Outstanding communication and relationship building skills, with the ability to build trust and influence across all levels</li> <li>Proven track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Results-oriented and committed to driving measurable impact</li> <li>Innovative operator, accustomed to leveraging technology (i.e. AI, tooling), to scale, improve and help the team operate more effectively</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Ideal Candidate:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Believes in Reddit’s mission</li> <li>Is organized and can build their own structure</li> <li>Is a strong communicator</li> <li>Is an optimist</li> <li>Is humble</li> <li>Can effectively communicate with everyone from engineers to sales </li> <li>Is fact-based, and willing to be hypothesis-driven</li> <li>Needs limited guidance and no instruction manual</li> <li>Acts as a force multiplier vs. a barrier to their executive partner</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li> <li>Family Planning Support </li> <li>Gender-Affirming Care</li> <li>Mental Health & Coaching Benefits</li> <li>Group Personal Pension Scheme with Employer match</li> <li>Private Medical and Dental Scheme</li> <li>Income Replacement Programs</li> <li>Bike to Work scheme</li> <li>Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Generous Paid Parental Leave</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial over time.</p> <p>As part of the WPP Media you’ll be encouraged to continuously learn, ask questions, and build craft excellence in a supportive team environment.</p> <p><strong>Key trends, anomalies, and opportunities to flag to clients and the wider team.</li> <li>Maintain internal trackers and documentation to support smooth delivery and transparency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Team Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work collaboratively with Search and wider channel teams to support client deliverables.</li> <li>Attend internal and client meetings where appropriate, building confidence in how search performance is discussed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Follow established processes and ways of working to minimise risk and ensure high standards of delivery.</li> <li>Support financial and operational hygiene by ensuring activity is accurately reflected in internal systems where required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Learning & Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Actively engage in training, certifications, and coaching to build paid search knowledge and capability.</li> <li>Seek feedback regularly and demonstrate progress against development goals.</li> <li>Contribute to team knowledge sharing by capturing learnings from tests, campaigns, or training.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. In this role, it will be important to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong> by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open environment</strong> by balancing people and client experiences through trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead Optimistically</strong> by championing growth and development.</li> </ul> <p>You will bring:</p> <ul> <li>A strong interest in paid search and digital marketing, with a desire to build a career in Search.</li> <li>Some hands-on experience or exposure to Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, or paid media platforms (through research, work, placements, or training).</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn technical and analytical skills.</li> <li>High degree of confidence working with numbers and data, with curiosity about what performance trends mean.</li> <li>Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.</li> <li>A proactive, organised approach to managing tasks and deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. Be able to communicate with clients on subject matters (even outside of your remit) and provide them with useful insight. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Take responsibility for your team’s development and career progression within the agency. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Play an active role in recruitment and interviewing processes to build strong teams. </li> </ul> <p><strong>External and Internal Communication </strong> </p> <ul> <li>Communication lead with the client contacts, media partners and internal stakeholders with the support of the Senior Associate Director when required.  </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Develop strong relationships with your client, and key suppliers. Foster a good working relationship across client team stakeholders to facilitate flawless execution of plans. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Process and Systems</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Helping to drive process automation through adoption of technology and efficient ways of working. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead on application and adherence to all areas of activation related finance process. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Contributes to the development of strategic revenue and services opportunities.  </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong> </p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values: </p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em> </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About you</strong> </p> <ul> <li>In-depth understanding of eCommerce campaign set-up, management, optimisation and reporting across media owner and technology vendor platforms including Amazon, Citrus, Criteo, bid management and Nielsen IQ or similar</li> <li>Amazon DSP and AMC capability beneficial</li> <li>Excellent understanding of the strategic and tactical application of eCommerce and digital marketing in general </li> <li>Proven project management, leadership and people management experience. </li> <li>Data-literate – aware of the available resources and how to turn data into insights that shape clear strategic opportunities </li> <li>Keen to drive continued specialism excellence and client account performance </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Operationally proficient </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Attention to detail </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Calm under pressure </li> </ul> <p> <br><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong> </p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. <br> <br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. </p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em> </p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide. </p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
description: About Lendable Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months. A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels. If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow. About the role We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app. No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks. What you'll work on Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team What we're looking for Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter. 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention You like days that look different from each other Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible. AI at Lendable We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to production themselves. You don't need to be an expert on day one, but we'll expect you to keep pushing what one person can do. Your team You'll report to the Senior Product Manager for Customer Management, and work most closely with: A developer and design team split across London and Europe, covering frontend and backend A data science team building models specific to the US business A credit risk team A growth team An operations team The team spans our London office, remote engineers in Europe, and our office in Arlington, Virginia, near DC, which you'll visit. Life at Lendable No one here is limited to their lane. If you want to pick up credit analysis, prototype a feature or fix something in ops, you will be supported. Work from home Mondays and Fridays, and be in the office Tuesday to Thursday, with lunches prepared by our top-tier in-house chefs Top-tier private health insurance Offsites for the US Cards product and engineering team, and an annual whole-company trip abroad (previously Turkey and France) Interview process We respect your time and move quickly: Intro call (remote) - 30 minutes with the hiring manager Take-home exercise (remote) - a practical product challenge in your own time, followed by a video debrief with two members of the product team Final round (in our London office) - typically with the CPO and US Cards MD, Engineering Manager, Head of Product and hiring manager Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner. Check out our blog ! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Lead, Machine Learning
description: About the Role There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things As Technical Lead, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems. You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product. What You'll Own Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment. Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models. Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance. Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability. Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data. Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models. Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements. Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance. What We're Looking For Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes. Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference. Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals. Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems. Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently. A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping. High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality. Outcomes Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets. ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable. Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact. Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction. Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time. Tech Stack Python PyTorch / JAX GPU-based training and inference system Ideal Experience You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos. You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes. You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness. How We Work We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently. We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional. Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. About the Role We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast. Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek. One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company. What You'll Do Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start. Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere. Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom. Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment. Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow. Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount. Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast. What You Bring Zero-to-one is your natural habitat. You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one. Operator and commercial in one person. You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter. AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task. Strong signals on top of that: An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces. Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them. Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations. Nice to Have Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch Established networks in international sourcing markets What You'll Get Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it Comprehensive healthcare coverage A collaborative team in a lovely office in the heart of East London Access to founders. We're a small team and they're heavily involved (and good fun!) Exclusive employee discounts to buy on Fleek Access to borrow any item from our collection of vintage and reworks in the office A disproportionate level of responsibility and the opportunity to drive massive impact How We Work Fleek is an in-office company. We're based at Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East). We operate a fully in-person culture at our office in Shoreditch, with trust-based flexibility. We hire adults and trust them to perform. The Practicalities Location: London HQ, Commercial Street, E1 (Liverpool Street / Aldgate East) Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth Team: 200 across three geographies Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held. Our Values Five values shape how we work at Fleek: Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach. Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done. Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate. Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre. Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter. Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you. title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Userlane Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally. Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications. Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't. You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?" You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does. You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike You're fluent in English (spoken and written) What's in for you Team & Culture : A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems Product strategy influence : Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors Market : Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry Growth : We take you and your development seriously. You can expect weekly 121s, a personalised skills assessment and development plan, on-the-job coaching and budget for events and training Benefits : We offer flexible benefits related to savings and security, health and well-being, and lifestyle and leisure Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.</p> <p>Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.</p></div><p><strong>London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens)</strong></p> <p><strong>You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.</li> <li>Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.</li> <li>Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.</li> <li>Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.</li> <li>Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the opportunity</strong></p> <p>We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.</p> <p>You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.</p> <p>You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.</p> <p>Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.</p> <p><strong>How you will make an impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.</li> <li>Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.</li> <li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.</li> <li>Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.</li> <li>Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.</li> <li>Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.</li> <li>Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.</li> <li>Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.</li> <li>Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. </li> <li>Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.</li> <li>Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.</li> <li>Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.</li> <li>Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.</li> <li>Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.</li> </ul> <p>Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.</p> <p><strong>Reporting structure</strong></p> <p>You’ll report directly to the <strong>General Manager, London</strong> for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.</p> <p>You’ll also work closely with our <strong>Head of Sales</strong>, participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.</p> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins</li> <li>Deal Review - 30 mins</li> <li>Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins</li> <li>Final Interview - ~3 hours</li> <li>Brief Background Check and Reference Check</li> </ul> <p>We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>The estimated compensation range for this role is <strong>£100,000-£240,000 OTE</strong>, depending on experience and skill set.</p> <p>Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.</p> <p>In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.</p> <p>Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Benefits </strong></p> <p>We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.</p> <ul> <li>🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits </li> <li>🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation</li> <li>➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance </li> <li>❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage</li> <li>💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff</li> <li>🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future</li> <li>🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families</li> <li>📚 Yearly learning and development stipend</li> <li>🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees</li> <li>🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office </li> <li>🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space</li> <li>🍔 Daily catered lunches provided </li> <li>✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely</li> <li>🥤 Monthly happy hours</li> <li>🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴</li> </ul> <p><strong>Workplace Policy</strong></p> <p>We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.</p> <p>Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. </p> <p>Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.</p> <p><strong>Candidate Privacy Notice</strong></p> <p>Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice <a href="https://pallet.com/privacy">here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations</strong></p> <p>Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. When a number looks wrong, you'll dig until you find why, and you'll come back with a fix as well as the problem.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here's what success in this role actually looks like:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain the pipelines that bring data from across the business into Databricks and Power BI, and automate the manual steps along the way</li> <li>Own the daily revenue and occupancy reporting that leadership uses to track how the GPU fleet is performing</li> <li>Check that what we bill matches what customers actually used, covering power draw, utilisation, asset registers and credits</li> <li>Support commission calculations and give sales leadership a clear view of pipeline health, conversion and churn</li> <li>Model pricing options and deal economics so investment decisions are grounded in real numbers</li> <li>Validate every figure before it reaches leadership or anyone outside the company</li> <li>Help the wider team work confidently with BI tools and data</li> </ul> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we'd like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As a member of Vanta’s Account Management team, you will be responsible for the expansion and retention of a subset of Vanta’s Customers by developing and maintaining strong relationships with our customers. You will serve as the primary point of contact for all post-sale commercial conversations, including mid-cycle upsells and renewals. As a trusted advisor to the customer, you will deeply understand their business needs and align Vanta’s solutions with their objectives to help mature our customers’ compliance and security programs. The goal of this team is to achieve overall net revenue expansion of the Vanta customer base, as measured by Net Revenue Retention. They will ensure customers’ security and compliance goals are aligned to their company growth needs and with Vanta’s solutions. This role will be based in our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. What you’ll do as an Account Manager [EMEA] at Vanta: Develop and maintain strong relationships with assigned accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner. Develop a deep understanding of Vanta’s current product offerings and take initiative to learn Vanta’s product roadmap to speak confidently when addressing customers. Maintain strong partnerships and alignment with CSMs to understand customer health, ensure close strategic collaboration and execute harmonious communication to accounts. Collaborate on account plans that identify new opportunities for expansion with current customers to increase their usage of Vanta’s platform via new frameworks, security tools, etc. Manage the entire sales cycle of any expansion or renewal opportunity from first meeting to close, negotiating where necessary and pulling in additional internal resources where appropriate (solutions consultants, subject matter experts, etc). Accurately forecast monthly expansion and churn, and maintain a clean SFDC instance with scrupulous pipeline hygiene. Keep a relentless focus on the customer needs and provide a consultative approach in architecting a solution. How to be successful in this role: 3+ years experience selling to or managing customers Fluency in written and spoken English, with a second European language preferred Must be able to work in our London office 3 days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday) Strong ability to prospect and build pipeline without assistance from BDR and/or inbound support Exceptional communication skills (written, verbal, visual), both for internal audiences and customer-facing messaging Be highly motivated with a sense of urgency and willingness to adjust Able to effectively collaborate with a wide range of departments including CS, Marketing, Enablement, and Support Previous experience in security and compliance is not required, but highly desirable Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact. What you can expect as a Vanta’n: Industry-competitive salary and equity 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office Pension matching 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time 8 company-paid holidays Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events! Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney #LI-hybrid At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. About Vanta We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent. You’re genuinely excited by restaurants, hospitality and the unique energy of dining culture. 🍽️</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What we can offer you...</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">5 weeks paid vacation</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Private health & dental insurance</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Focus on mental health and well-being:</span></li> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Company-paid subscription to Headspace</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Annual company-wide week off a year - This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Work Environment & Flexibility</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Inclusion</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you.
